Frequently asked questions
How quickly can I launch my AI Receptionist?

With Quality Studio, launch your AI Receptionist in ~15 minutes. Set up your profile, define your goals and scenarios, run a simulated test call, and apply actionable recommendations, then go live with confidence.
Will callers know they are speaking to AI?
Yes. AI Receptionist uses a conversational voice, and businesses can customize greetings to introduce the service transparently and professionally.
How does AI Receptionist save businesses money compared to hiring in-house staff?
AI Receptionist offers 24/7 call handling without hiring, training, or managing staff — reducing overhead while ensuring no missed calls. Plus, you can try it free forever.
Why is my credit card required to sign up?

On our free tier, overages are off by default; you decide if and when to turn them on. Keeping a card on file means that when you do, we can add call credits right away so your coverage never lapses. Turning on overages authorizes those charges; you can switch it off anytime, and we won’t charge your card otherwise.
How does Smith.ai ensure call quality with AI Receptionist?

Every call is recorded and transcribed, providing a verifiable record for quality assurance, training, and business documentation. We’ve also released a new measurable standard, the AI Quality Index (AQI), along with our quality loop. AQI scores measure against the AI Receptionist’s ability to follow your standard of call handling according to the goals you set, plus the overall caller experience. With the quality loop, you get tailored recommendations on how to improve your AI Receptionist’s performance, thus improving the quality of your calls and your AQI score.
Is caller data secure with AI Receptionist?
Yes. Smith.ai follows strict security protocols, including encrypted storage for call recordings and transcripts.
Can AI Receptionist integrate with my CRM and other tools?
Yes. AI Receptionist natively integrates with Salesforce, HubSpot, Clio Grow, Clio Manage, plus 5,000+ apps either natively, or through Zapier and Make.
What is live agent involvement?

While AI Receptionist can professionally screen & qualify leads, intake prospective clients, answer questions, and book appointments, occasionally, call scenarios that require a human receptionist pop up. For these, our 500+ North America-based receptionists are available through our Live Agent Network as a per-call add-on. If you have unique call scenarios and want to tailor which calls are escalated to our human receptionists to match your business needs, learn about our Hybrid solution here .
Is there an extra fee when a call escalates from AI to a human receptionist?

If the escalation is AI-initiated, there is no fee. If you choose to implement live agent involvement for information verification or scheduling, it is available as a per-call add-on to any AI Receptionist plan.
